root_idea.summary: A sound root denoting protrusion, projection, or elevation in a thing.
root_idea.development: The lexical development extends from projecting ankle bones and joints to reed joints, breast prominence, cubic or square forms, compact lumps, and figurative eminence. These related developments are not all direct meanings of the Quranic forms.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic proper noun is presented under the normalized citation form كَعْبَة.
The inflected Quranic dual is presented under the singular dictionary headword كَعْب.
The Quranic plural is normalized to the singular active-participle headword كَاعِب.

senses.definition: The Sacred House at Mecca, the square or cubic sanctuary known as the Kaaba.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, this is a proper name for the Sacred House.

senses.definition: An ankle bone or ankle joint at the junction of the lower leg and foot.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic dual كَعْبَيْنِ denotes the two ankle bones or joints.

senses.definition: A young woman whose breasts have begun to swell and become prominent.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural كَوَاعِبَ is substantivized for such women and is paired with the description of being alike in age. The adjective may also qualify the breast itself when it is swelling or prominent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To swell, become prominent, or protrude, especially of the breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the breast's development or prominence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike someone on a hard or projecting part, such as the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object struck is a hard or protuberant part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fill a vessel.
To put forth joints or a jointed stem; figuratively, to grow or develop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative use may describe something growing like a reed putting forth its joints.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To furnish a breast-band with projecting edges or borders.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is used of a breast-band belonging to a beast of carriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make square or cubic, or to fold a garment firmly into such a form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to folding cloth and to giving something a square or cubic shape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten or go away heedlessly, without concern for what is left behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A further attested nuance is going away injuriously or without regard for those left behind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A joint, juncture, or place of division in bones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the broader anatomical sense underlying more specific applications of the word.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a quadruped, the projecting hock or tarsal region between the lower leg and foot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is applied to the corresponding joint or projecting structure in quadrupeds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A play-bone or small die, including the astragalus or an ossicle used in games.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural forms include كِعَاب and related game terminology.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cube in the terminology of arithmetic.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical mathematical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A compact lump or piece of clarified butter, fat, dates, or milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can denote a compact quantity or mass of these substances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A knot, joint, or intervening section of a reed or cane; similarly, a joint of a reed spear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer either to the prominent knot or to the portion between two knots, and may describe regular spear joints.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A party or faction formed when a people become divided in mind or opinion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative usage compares the divided groups to separated play-bones or joints of a reed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Eminence, nobility, glory, or elevated standing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions wishing or describing the exaltation of a person's glory; the sense is extended from something elevated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A girl's or woman's breast when swelling, prominent, or protuberant.
A square or cubic house, chamber, or room.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the generic architectural use distinct from the proper name of the Sacred House.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A house or temple belonging to the tribe of Rabīʿah, around which they performed circuits.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A pre-Islamic cultic house referred to by the plural expression الكَعَبَات or ذُو الكَعَبَات.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A girl's virginity or maidenhead.
A hair arrangement made by interlacing four plaits, and the corresponding method of dressing the hair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied lexical entry includes both the hair arrangement and the associated coiffure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A virgin girl or woman.
Variegated or figured with squares, especially a checkered garment or cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective may be applied to a garment or more generally to something patterned in squares.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or piece of cloth folded hard or firmly, in a square form according to one explanation.
Hard and projecting, especially of a face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression وَجْدٌ مُكَعِّبٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A type of basket.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for the basket known by the names دَوْحَلَّة, شَوْغَرَة, and وَشَخَة.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Illustrative example adding no lexical branch.
Editorial comment about possible quadriliteral classification.

cautions: The inflected Quranic dual كَعْبَيْنِ is normalized to the singular headword كَعْب while retaining its Quranic dual sense.

The supplied Lane discussion questions whether the كُعْكُبّ and كُعْكُبَّة hair terms belong in a separate quadriliteral article; they are retained here because the material lexical entries occur in the supplied primary root record.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Lane entry 28302, subunit g1:sub5 associates the play-bone meaning with a historical citation written as “Kur v. 92.” The notation is not converted into a modern verse location, and the citation does not securely identify a Quran occurrence of the play-bone lexical item.
